title: Wide slot, top down
narration: An eight node pipeline laid out top to bottom in a wide, short slot. Five of its eight edges carry labels; each label must stay clear of every arrow, every node and every other label.

A -->|briefing| R[Reader]
A -->|evidence| L(Concept ledger)
